layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records
Add integration test for denied exports
Document CSV export in usage guide
Record final review finding on synchronization record

graderOnly: test/integration/export-access.test.ts holds the only test of denied export requests (no user, viewer, editor). Neither established command runs it: `pnpm --filter export test` runs test/*.test.ts and `pnpm --filter export test:integration` runs only test/integration/export-flow.test.ts (2 tests). No record holds an execution result for it.

The verification report's AC-002 row cites export-access.test.ts as 'Verified: E2', but E2 ran 2 tests, both in export-flow.test.ts; the implementation review (R2) and final review (C2) relied on that claim. This is a Tester-owned VERIFICATION gap, independent of D-001, of F-001, and of both recovery frames.
Run directly, the access test passes; the implementation satisfies AC-002. A Synchronizer run of it is a diagnostic, not formal Tester evidence.

Recovery: Frame 1 From SYNCHRONIZING, Owner REVIEWING_FINAL, FailureType REVIEW, ResumeAt SYNCHRONIZING, RerunThrough NONE (Reviewer's pending citation correction); Frame 2 (active) From REVIEWING_FINAL, Owner SYNCHRONIZING, FailureType SYNCHRONIZATION, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough NONE.

The Synchronizer's correction of D-001 is already made and accurate: the only 'Verification E3' citation in final-deliverable.md is in the AC-001 row for the 201 response; Reviewer is waiting to reassess final-deliverable.md#F-001.
Otherwise the records are consistent: cited commits and blobs match HEAD, the guide matches the code, and the tree is clean.

notes: Built on export-project rather than export-synchronizing: the case needs an authorization test that was never executed, which contradicts export-synchronizing's records (its E2 ran the denied test). Layers 50-70 replay that cycle in compact form with one change: the denied-export test is in its own file test/integration/export-access.test.ts (layer 60), which neither test (test/*.test.ts) nor test:integration (export-flow.test.ts only) runs. Verification cites it for AC-002 as 'Verified: E2' while E2 records tests 2, pass 2; implementation review R2, documentation G2, and final review C2 report 2 passed. The first final review also cites a nonexistent 'Verification E3' in the AC-001 201-response row. Layer 72: first Synchronizer pass records D-001 (wrongly naming the AC-002 row) and routes REVIEW (Frame 1). Layer 74: Reviewer reopens the final review (IN_PROGRESS), records F-001 (Owner Synchronizer) and routes SYNCHRONIZATION (Frame 2: From REVIEWING_FINAL, Owner SYNCHRONIZING, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough NONE). Layer 76: an earlier Synchronizer session corrected and verified D-001 without handing off; its record says AC-001/AC-002 execution evidence is not yet reconciled. The case's active frame matches Frame 2; the catalog suggested one frame, but a frame From REVIEWING_FINAL with an existing synchronization record is only reachable with Reviewer's own frame beneath it, so there are two. A correct run pushes Frame 3 (From SYNCHRONIZING, Owner TESTING, VERIFICATION). The development plan is committed after the code (layer 58) to keep the fixture small.
